title: API adoption
description: A declared consumption of an API by a service on a specific major line — the versioned twin of service.consumes_apis, which only says THAT a service consumes an API. A relation entity like workload, since Port relations carry no properties. Declared, never observed: it records what a team states it runs and who verified it when; runtime evidence lives outside Toadie. Convention: the api should be among the consumer's consumes_apis (not validated). Port-only.

major_line.title: Major line
major_line.description: The major line consumed, e.g. `v2`. Absent = the consumer has not declared one (unknown adoption is valid).

status.title: Status
status.description: Where this consumer stands on the line.

verified_at.title: Verified at
verified_at.description: When the declaration was last confirmed.
